ev.q: the adjusted VE against hospitalization was 34.5%
Overall, 21.3% of SARI patients were vaccinated
Among 3,848 influenza case-patients, 704 (18.3%) had received a 2024 seasonal influenza vaccine
using multivariable logistic regression, overall and by target group
Analyses were stratified by influenza type and subtype when at least five patients contributed to each stratum
using a test-negative case-control study design

methods_quotes.q: VE was calculated by comparing the odds of influenza vaccination between influenza test-positive SARI case-patients and influenza test-negative control patients using multivariable logistic regression
Analyses were stratified by influenza type and subtype when at least five patients contributed to each stratum
models were adjusted for country, sex, age in years (cubic spline), week of symptom onset (cubic spline)
VE was estimated using multivariable logistic regression as (1 − adjusted odds ratio) × 100%.
